title: [SOA] Disable available-items-only search by default
summary: The Sales Order Agent now initializes the Search Only Available Items setting to disabled by default, allowing the agent to search all items unless administrators explicitly restrict it.
key_points: Search Only Available Items defaults to false instead of true for new SOA setups
Administrators can still enable the restriction when needed
Existing setup records are not affected
Applies only during default setup initialization
quote: This change disables the setting by default so the agent searches all items unless an administrator explicitly enables the availability restriction.
